exercises.title: Past Simple — Recupera
exercises.description: Ricostruisci il Past Simple partendo dagli eventi conclusi: affermative, did/didn't, spelling regolare, pochi irregolari essenziali e was/were.
exercises.instructions: Prima riconosci che il tempo è concluso; poi costruisci la forma corretta.

sections.title: Capisci il passato concluso
sections.instructions: Non partire dalla lista dei verbi: parti da quando l'azione è finita.

questions.title: Past Simple: un passato che è finito
questions.prompt: Prima di esercitarti
questions.instructions: Osserva significato e struttura, poi passa alla pratica.
questions.learning_objective: Use the past simple for finished past events with correct affirmative forms, did/didn't structures, time expressions and basic was/were support.

content.body: Usa il Past Simple per eventi e situazioni conclusi in un tempo passato finito. Nell'affermativa il verbo va al passato; con did e didn't il verbo principale torna alla forma base.
content.intro: La regola più importante non è memorizzare -ed: è distinguere l'affermativa, dove il verbo porta il passato, dalle domande e negative, dove il passato è già espresso da did/didn't.

sections.title: Un evento concluso
sections.body: Il Past Simple descrive qualcosa che è successo e si è concluso in un tempo passato finito, spesso indicato dal contesto.

examples.text: I visited my aunt last Sunday.
We went home after the film.

sections.title: Nell'affermativa il verbo va al passato
sections.body: I verbi regolari formano il passato con -ed o una variante ortografica. Alcuni verbi molto frequenti sono irregolari e cambiano forma.

sections.title: Did e didn't prendono il passato al posto del verbo
sections.body: Nelle domande e negative con i verbi normali usa did/didn't + forma base. Non mettere di nuovo il verbo al passato.
sections.pattern: Did + subject + base verb? · subject + didn't + base verb

sections.title: Non mettere il passato due volte
sections.body: Dopo did o didn't usa la forma base, anche se il verbo è irregolare nell'affermativa.

sections.title: Il contesto ti dice che il tempo è finito
sections.body: Yesterday, last weekend, two days ago e in 2024 sono esempi comuni di tempo passato concluso. Non servono in ogni frase: anche il contesto può rendere chiaro che l'evento è finito.

sections.title: Con be: was e were, senza did
sections.body: Il passato di be è was/were. Nelle domande inverti was/were e soggetto; nelle negative usa wasn't/weren't. Non usare did con be.

examples.text: I was tired after the trip.

sections.title: Prima di continuare
points: Evento concluso in un tempo passato finito → Past Simple.
Impara pochi irregolari frequenti nel contesto; il ripasso sistematico viene nel topic successivo.
Be usa was/were e non did.

questions.title: Perché usiamo il Past Simple?
questions.prompt: I finished the report at six and sent it to my teacher before dinner.
questions.learning_objective: Recognise a sequence of completed events in a finished past context.

options.text: Entrambe le azioni sono concluse in un momento passato finito.

feedback.explanation: Finished e sent raccontano due eventi conclusi prima del momento presente.

questions.title: Forma i verbi regolari
questions.prompt: Completa le due frasi.
questions.instructions: Scegli la grafia corretta del Past Simple.
questions.learning_objective: Apply common regular past spelling patterns.

content.text_template: We [[blank_1]] (live) in Parma for a year, and my sister [[blank_2]] (study) there too.

accepted_answers: lived
studied

feedback.explanation: Live termina in -e → lived. Study termina in consonante + y → studied.

questions.title: Dopo did cambia il verbo
questions.prompt: Correggi: Did you went to the match on Saturday?
questions.learning_objective: Use the base verb after did in a past simple question.

accepted_answers: Did you go to the match on Saturday?

feedback.explanation: Did porta già il passato: dopo did usa go, non went.

questions.title: Affermativa e negativa nello stesso evento
questions.prompt: Ieri ho visto Marco, ma non ho parlato con lui.
questions.learning_objective: Combine an irregular affirmative past form with a didn't + base verb negative.

accepted_answers: I saw Marco yesterday, but I didn't talk to him.
Yesterday I saw Marco, but I didn't talk to him.
I saw Marco yesterday, but I did not talk to him.
Yesterday I saw Marco, but I did not talk to him.

feedback.explanation: See → saw nell'affermativa; dopo didn't torna la forma base talk.

questions.title: Con be la struttura è diversa
questions.prompt: ___ your parents at home last night?
questions.learning_objective: Form a past question with were rather than did.

feedback.explanation: Your parents = they → were. Con be non usi did.

exercises.title: Past Simple — Allenati
exercises.description: Recupero attivo su eventi conclusi, regolari, irregolari frequenti, did/didn't, domande, negative, was/were e indicatori di tempo.
exercises.instructions: Lavora dal contesto: scegli la struttura e poi controlla la forma del verbo.

sections.title: Racconta cosa è successo
sections.instructions: Non trasformare tutto in una tabella: usa il verbo dentro una situazione.

questions.title: Un sabato complicato
questions.prompt: Completa il mini-racconto con il Past Simple dei verbi tra parentesi.
questions.instructions: Scrivi la forma corretta richiesta dal contesto.
questions.learning_objective: Produce regular and high-frequency irregular past forms across a connected sequence.

content.text_template: On Saturday, we [[blank_1]] (plan) to catch the 9:00 train, but we [[blank_2]] (get) to the station late. We [[blank_3]] (miss) the train, so my dad [[blank_4]] (take) us by car.

accepted_answers: planned
got
missed
took

feedback.explanation: Planned/missed sono regolari; get → got e take → took sono irregolari frequenti.

questions.title: Correggi il messaggio
questions.prompt: Correggi: Sara didn't studied for the test last night.
questions.learning_objective: Use the base verb after didn't in a finished-past negative.

accepted_answers: Sara didn't study for the test last night.
Sara did not study for the test last night.

feedback.explanation: Didn't esprime già il passato: il verbo torna a study.

questions.title: Chiedi un dettaglio sul weekend
questions.prompt: Metti le parti nell'ordine corretto.
questions.learning_objective: Build a past simple wh-question with did and a base verb.

feedback.explanation: Where + did + you + have...? Dopo did resta have.

questions.title: Quali frasi raccontano correttamente ieri?
questions.prompt: Yesterday was busy. Seleziona tutte le frasi grammaticalmente corrette.
questions.instructions: Può esserci più di una risposta.
questions.learning_objective: Recognise correct regular, irregular, question and negative past simple forms.

options.text: I went to the supermarket after work.

feedback.explanation: Worked/went sono forme affermative corrette; dopo didn't/did servono buy/see.

questions.title: Spiega perché sei arrivato tardi
questions.prompt: Ho perso l'autobus, quindi sono arrivato a scuola alle nove.
questions.learning_objective: Produce two completed past events using natural regular and irregular forms.

accepted_answers: I missed the bus, so I arrived at school at nine.
I missed my bus, so I arrived at school at nine.
I missed the bus, so I got to school at nine.
I missed my bus, so I got to school at nine.

feedback.explanation: Entrambe le azioni sono concluse: missed + arrived/got.

questions.title: Il tempo è già finito
questions.prompt: Completa le frasi con la forma corretta.
questions.learning_objective: Use past simple forms with clearly finished past time expressions.

content.text_template: Two days ago, Marta [[blank_1]] a new laptop. Last night, she [[blank_2]] it for the first time.

accepted_answers: bought
used

feedback.explanation: Two days ago e last night indicano tempi conclusi: bought, used.

questions.title: Parlare di un evento finito
questions.prompt: Scegli la risposta coerente e grammaticalmente corretta.
questions.learning_objective: Use did + base verb and an irregular affirmative naturally in a short past-time dialogue.

content.scenario: Two friends talk on Monday about the weekend.

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Did you go to Luca's party on Saturday?

options.text: I did left at about eleven.
I leave at about eleven last Saturday.

feedback.explanation: La risposta affermativa usa il passato del verbo: left.

questions.title: Dove eravate?
questions.prompt: Completa le informazioni sul concerto.
questions.instructions: Scegli la forma corretta di be al passato.
questions.learning_objective: Use was/were accurately in affirmative and negative past descriptions.

content.text_template: The concert [[blank_1]] great, but our seats [[blank_2]] very close to the stage.

accepted_answers: was
weren't

feedback.explanation: Concert = it → was. Seats = they → weren't.

exercises.title: Past Simple — Modalità scuola
exercises.description: Applica il Past Simple in esercizi tipici di una verifica scolastica, senza correzioni durante lo svolgimento.
exercises.instructions: Completa tutti gli esercizi prima di vedere feedback e risposte.

questions.title: Complete the text
questions.prompt: Put the verbs in brackets into the Past Simple.
questions.learning_objective: Produce regular, irregular and negative past simple forms in a connected school-style text.

content.text_template: Last Friday our class [[blank_1]] (visit) a science museum. We [[blank_2]] (leave) school at eight and [[blank_3]] (get) there before ten. I [[blank_4]] (not/buy) anything in the shop, but my friend [[blank_5]] (take) lots of photos.

accepted_answers: visited
left
got
didn't buy
did not buy
took

feedback.explanation: Il testo usa un passato concluso: visited, left, got, didn't buy, took.

questions.title: Correct the mistake
questions.prompt: Correct: Did Laura saw the message yesterday?
questions.learning_objective: Correct a past simple question containing a double past marker.

accepted_answers: Did Laura see the message yesterday?

feedback.explanation: Dopo did usa see, non saw.

questions.title: Make a question
questions.prompt: Put the words in the correct order.
questions.learning_objective: Build a past simple wh-question with did.

feedback.explanation: When + did + the lesson + finish?

questions.title: Translate
questions.prompt: Non siamo usciti ieri sera perché eravamo stanchi.
questions.learning_objective: Translate a didn't + base verb negative and a was/were past state accurately.

accepted_answers: We didn't go out last night because we were tired.
We did not go out last night because we were tired.
We didn't go out yesterday evening because we were tired.
We did not go out yesterday evening because we were tired.

feedback.explanation: Didn't go usa la forma base; we were tired usa be al passato.

questions.title: Choose the correct sentence
questions.prompt: Which sentence is correct?
questions.learning_objective: Recognise a correct irregular past affirmative form.

options.text: We made dinner at home last night.
We maked dinner at home last night.
We did made dinner at home last night.
We make dinner at home last night.

feedback.explanation: Make è irregolare: made.

questions.title: Complete with was or were
questions.prompt: Complete the sentences.
questions.learning_objective: Use was/were accurately in a school-style completion task.

content.text_template: The weather [[blank_1]] terrible, but the cafés [[blank_2]] open.

accepted_answers: was
were

feedback.explanation: Weather = it → was; cafés = they → were.

exercises.title: Past Simple — Mini-verifica
exercises.description: Controlla se sai riconoscere e produrre il Past Simple in autonomia, incluse domande, negative e un piccolo campione di was/were.
exercises.instructions: Completa senza aiuti. Obiettivo consigliato: almeno 80%.

questions.title: Scegli il tempo corretto
questions.prompt: The school trip ended on Friday. We ___ home at six that evening.
questions.learning_objective: Recognise a finished past context and choose the past simple.

feedback.explanation: The trip ended e that evening rendono il contesto chiaramente concluso: came.

questions.title: Spelling regolare
questions.prompt: Completa con la forma corretta.
questions.learning_objective: Apply two common regular past spelling rules independently.

content.text_template: Yesterday, Mia [[blank_1]] for the test and then [[blank_2]] at her friend's house.

accepted_answers: studied
stopped

feedback.explanation: Study → studied; stop → stopped.

questions.title: Irregolari frequenti in contesto
questions.prompt: Completa con il Past Simple dei verbi tra parentesi.
questions.learning_objective: Produce two high-frequency irregular past forms in context.

content.text_template: We [[blank_1]] (see) the new film and then [[blank_2]] (have) dinner near the cinema.

accepted_answers: saw
had

feedback.explanation: See → saw; have → had.

questions.title: Correggi la negativa
questions.prompt: Correggi: We didn't went out after dinner.
questions.learning_objective: Use the base verb after didn't independently.

accepted_answers: We didn't go out after dinner.
We did not go out after dinner.

feedback.explanation: Didn't + go, non didn't went.

questions.title: Costruisci la domanda
questions.prompt: Metti le parti nell'ordine corretto.
questions.learning_objective: Build a correct past simple wh-question independently.

feedback.explanation: Why + did + Sara + leave + early?

questions.title: Was o were?
questions.prompt: The shops ___ closed when we arrived.
questions.learning_objective: Choose the correct past form of be with a plural subject.

feedback.explanation: The shops = they → were.

questions.title: Domanda e risposta sul passato
questions.prompt: Hai visto Giulia ieri? No, non l'ho vista.
questions.learning_objective: Produce did + base verb in a question and didn't + base verb in a negative answer.

accepted_answers: Did you see Giulia yesterday? No, I didn't see her.
Did you see Giulia yesterday? No, I did not see her.
Did you see Giulia yesterday? No, I didn't.
Did you see Giulia yesterday? No, I did not.

feedback.explanation: Did you see...? e didn't see / didn't: dopo did/didn't la forma è see.

questions.title: Ultimo controllo
questions.prompt: Seleziona tutte le frasi corrette.
questions.instructions: Valuta sia il tempo sia la forma.
questions.learning_objective: Recognise accurate affirmative, negative, question and time-expression uses of the past simple.

options.text: I called her two days ago.
We go to Rome last weekend.

feedback.explanation: Called e Did...come sono corretti; dopo didn't serve take; last weekend richiede qui went.
